keys:
Talk to Koby on every island: he gives you its mission.

WASD / arrows: move  ·  Shift: run
Space: jump (in the water: swim up)
Left click / J: attack  ·  R: skill  ·  F: switch skill  ·  K: skill shop
Q: eat  ·  Tab: switch item  ·  M: map
E: talk / take the helm  ·  Mouse: camera  ·  Esc: pause

On a phone: joystick on the left, drag on the right for the camera and use the buttons.

Espacio: saltar (en el agua: subir nadando)
